what_landed: Two coupled scenarios that arm the two windows in which the pair engine re-prices a packet it already authored, and the derived guard that makes arming them mandatory. survival.pricing.price_declared_packet prices a declaration at the ONE effective resistance a fight publishes, while the pair engine re-prices authored packets once the complete ledger exists -- damage._apply_temporary_lethality_windows rescales later timestamped physical packets by the ratio of a new and old armour multiplier, damage._apply_liandry_reprice folds a raised maximum health back onto every burn tick after a lifeline. Measured over every committed coupled scenario and every bench roster before the first edit: NONE arms a temporary-lethality window and NONE holds a Liandry burn row, so both terms are invisible to both baselines -- which is exactly why the active_cast retirement's R-20 line read a green zero over a population that could not contain the defect (docs/receipts/expected-golden-diff-campaign-close-active-cast-retirement.json, gap-ledger row G4). lethality_window_assassin_roster -- Zed with Voltaic Cyclosword, Eclipse and Serylda's Grudge, attacking at full uptime -- arms the lethality window: Firmament grants its 15 flat lethality after its own energized packet and the window rescales 8 later physical events, among them proc_Eclipse, which is the cast_proc family the stopped retirement names as blocked next by the same term. liandry_reprice_mage_roster -- Ahri with Liandry's Torment, Rabadon's Deathcap and Void Staff into a Malphite holding Protoplasm Harness -- arms the max-health reprice, the one window a holder's own items cannot cover: it joins an attacker's max-health-scaled burn to a defender's lifeline. golden_snapshot.capture_coupled now refuses to capture while either window is unarmed, reading the window mapping from the behaviour catalog over every owner in rule_owners() (R-12) rather than from a list typed here, so a third re-pricing window fails the capture on the commit that declares it.

landed_against.rule: R-17/R-32/D-97 -- no baseline moves inside this commit; the capture is the integration agent's own next commit, which is the order Ruling 3 inherits from Amendment M's Ruling 2 and Amendment L's before it: scenario, then re-capture, then the pricing stage that needs to be seen.

no_src_change: This slice edits scripts/, tests/ and two plan locators only. It adds a measurement surface and changes nothing the calculator computes, which is why every leaf below is a new row rather than a moved one.

qualifying_population.rule: R-20's second half. The count is not readable off the pre-change tree by inspection, because a scenario the baseline does not hold has no leaves to inspect. The population is therefore enumerated from the committed artifacts -- scripts/golden_coupled_baseline.json's own seventeen scenario keys and its metadata block -- before the first edit, and any occurrence outside it stops the slice.
qualifying_population.method: A scenario key the committed baseline does not hold is reported by leaf_report ONCE, at the node, as a single absent_to_value membership transition: _leaf_diffs recurses into a mapping only when BOTH sides are mappings, so an absent subtree is never fanned out into leaves that have no counterpart. Two new scenarios are therefore two occurrences and not two subtrees' worth. Beside them, the snapshot's own derived shape counters move because the scenario set gained members: the metadata block publishes four of them, enumerated by name below. This is the same population shape the two previous covering-scenario acts enumerated, for the same reason and by the same reading.
qualifying_population.no_committed_leaf_moves: Every leaf the committed baseline already holds is untouched: the difference set is exactly the six paths above, so the seventeen scenarios captured before this slice are byte-identical, and scripts/golden_coupled_exact.json reproduces every per-attacker total it already holds.

the_supersession_claim_lands_with_the_ca: /metadata/fingerprint/leaves is one of the sixty escalated-defects-P4-boundary.json pins, and its live claim is the amp-armed allowlist's. The claim that replaces it is a statement about a baseline that has moved, so it is written in the capture commit beside the move it describes, not here -- which is also what keeps this commit from asserting a value the committed baseline does not yet hold. The same ordering the previous covering-scenario act used, for the same reason.

oracle_pass.why: R-15's amendment of 2026-08-14: a membership transition that is the ruled consequence of a declared change is adjudicated BY CITATION, not by verdict. Both scenario occurrences are absent_to_value as the identity-keyed leaf_report classifies them, which is the amendment's first guard; they are rows a captured snapshot did not hold because the scenario did not exist, not values that moved. The ruling that puts them there is one a reader can open, which is the amendment's second guard: the umbrella's Amendment N, Ruling 3 -- 'By integration act (R-12, R-32 -- a baseline moves in the integration agent's own commit and never inside a semantic slice), the covering scenario set gains at least one scenario arming a temporary-lethality window -- a Voltaic Cyclosword holder whose Firmament actually fires -- and at least one arming the Liandry reprice.' No oracle receipt is owed on either, and one may not be filed as though the question were a value question: no cached wiki text and no formula in docs/math-foundations.md decides whether a roster should be measured.
oracle_pass.the_four_shape_counters: They are not behaviour leaves and they are not adjudicable by an oracle: they count the snapshot's own shape, and no cached wiki text decides how many leaves a snapshot has. Umbrella criterion 4 disowns them to docs/receipts/campaign-fingerprints.json, which is their sole home, and the capture commit that moves them carries their one line of cause (R-34). They are listed under coupled_golden_shape_counters rather than beside the behaviour leaves for exactly that reason -- the allowlist mechanism keeps the two apart, and this receipt states no value of any of them beyond the one leaf whose supersession chain obliges it.
oracle_pass.what_an_oracle_would_still_be_owed: Any movement of a leaf the committed baseline already holds. There is none: the pair baseline reads 'snapshot identical', and the coupled difference set is the six paths enumerated above and nothing else.

armed_means_fired.rule: Ruling 3's own words: 'Armed means fired: a holder whose window opens on no packet is the same emptiness with a scenario name on it.' The capture guard can only see what a scenario EQUIPS, so firing is measured rather than assumed, by gated tests reading the captured entries.
armed_means_fired.temporary_lethality: The engine publishes what the window reached. The on_hit_once_Voltaic Cyclosword_ability row carries a temporary_lethality receipt whose applied_event_count is 8 on this roster, whose amount and duration are asserted equal to the values the declaration's own ValueRefs name, and whose effect is measured as a ratio: every basic attack inside the window meets the target at the published effective armour less the declared lethality and every one after it meets the published figure, so the step between them is the ratio of the two armour multipliers. tests/test_golden_snapshot.py::TestRepricingWindowCoverage::test_the_lethality_window_reprices_the_packets_inside_it is that measurement, gated.
armed_means_fired.threshold_health_bonus: Both sides of the join have to show up for the fight to be a measurement. The captured fight publishes threshold_health_triggered true and a positive threshold_health_bonus_gained -- the defender's declaration firing -- and the attacker's burn ticks step up strictly afterwards by the ratio the raised maximum implies, asserted against the fight's own published target_effective_max_health. tests/test_golden_snapshot.py::TestRepricingWindowCoverage::test_the_mage_roster_fires_the_max_health_reprice is that measurement, gated.

the_departure_from_the_shared_duration.what_ruling_3_requires: The amendment's own measured block: 'The integration act's magic scenario must depart from the roster set's shared duration, with the departure stated rather than tuned until green.'
the_departure_from_the_shared_duration.the_departure: liandry_reprice_mage_roster runs a five-second fight where every other roster scenario runs eight.
the_departure_from_the_shared_duration.why_it_is_the_mechanic_and_not_a_tuned_n: A fight that reaches the lifeline's own expiry is WITHHELD rather than priced -- threshold_defense.ThresholdExpiryWithheld, raised because the sourced Wiki data does not document what the temporary maximum does to current health when it lapses. Measured on this roster: the lifeline arms at t = 2.5 s and expires at 7.5 s, so the shared eight seconds captures nothing at all rather than capturing a smaller number. tests/test_golden_snapshot.py::TestRepricingWindowCoverage::test_the_mage_roster_departs_from_the_shared_duration pins that by re-running the same request at eight seconds and requiring the withholding, so nobody simplifies the scenario back onto the shared duration.
the_departure_from_the_shared_duration.envelope: The amendment measured the arming envelope as a 3-to-5 second fight against a level-18 Protoplasm holder. Five is the top of that envelope and is what this scenario uses.

the_window_mapping_is_two_joins.what_ruling_3_requires: 'The coverage derivation reads the window mapping, the way holder_amp_declarations already reads the amp-kind mapping and receipt_walk_families the family-to-owner join, so a future re-pricing window that no scenario arms fails the capture on the commit that declares it rather than being discovered by whoever next re-prices.'
the_window_mapping_is_two_joins.the_two_joins: The amendment's own measured block records that a mapping keyed only on the holder's items would report the magic half covered by an empty set. golden_snapshot.repricing_window_declarations therefore returns, per window, a tuple of SIDES, and a covering scenario is one that equips a declaring item of every side. The lethality window has one side -- the items whose EmpoweredHitRule carries a TemporaryLethality payload, which is Voltaic Cyclosword alone over all 143 owners in rule_owners(). The max-health window has two -- the items whose periodic damage carries a Basis.TARGET_MAX_HEALTH term, which is Liandry's Torment alone, and the items whose threshold defence writes DefenseField.THRESHOLD_HEALTH_BONUS, which is Protoplasm Harness alone.
the_window_mapping_is_two_joins.the_kind_names_are_derived_too: Neither window's key is a label invented in the instrument: LETHALITY_WINDOW is the EmpoweredHitRule field that carries the payload and MAX_HEALTH_WINDOW is the DefenseField a lifeline writes, both read from the declaration vocabulary, so a rename in either arrives as a renamed window rather than as a guard that quietly stopped matching.
the_window_mapping_is_two_joins.one_predicate: window_covering_scenarios composes the one covering_scenarios predicate across a window's sides rather than spelling covering a second time, which is the discipline the producer, family and amp readings already share.
the_window_mapping_is_two_joins.what_this_does_not_do: It does not perform Ruling 2. The census of every post-authoring packet-mutation site, and the gate that each enumerated site is covered by a pricing-stage term or a ruled exclusion, is a separate act and remains owed; this derivation reads the two windows the tree declares today and fails the capture on a third that no scenario arms.

r05_negatives.an_unarmed_window: capture_coupled(windows=...) is the seam and test_a_window_no_scenario_arms_fails_the_capture drives a third window kind through it.
r05_negatives.a_half_armed_window: test_a_window_only_one_side_of_which_is_equipped_fails_the_capture adds a second, unequipped side to the window a one-sided reading would already call covered. It is what proves the guard intersects a window's sides rather than unioning them -- the failure mode the amendment measured in advance.

measured.golden: compare clean -- 'OK: snapshot identical'. This slice enters through neither pipeline.run_fight nor any src/ path (R-11).
measured.coupled_golden: 6 differing leaves, 6 qualifying under R-15, all six inside the enumerated population, zero outside it. R-15's ratio clause is not triggered: the differing-leaf count is 0.04% of the numeric leaves, read from the report's own denominator.
measured.one_physical_cause: The coupled scenario set gained two members. Nothing the calculator computes changed, and no leaf that existed before this slice differs.
measured.the_terms_themselves: Reproduced rather than asserted, on both windows, by the two gated measurements named under armed_means_fired. The lethality window's step is the armour-multiplier ratio its declared lethality implies; the reprice's step is the max-health ratio the defender's lifeline implies. Those are the two terms Amendment N's Ruling 1 says the walk's from-declaration price does not yet carry, and this is the baseline being able to see them.

the_locators_this_slice_shifted.rule: R-37's same-commit clause: a slice that itself shifts a cited line refreshes that locator in the same commit, and a locator refresh is not a semantic change so R-30 does not bind it.
